expectations.text: Defines the CDE and 'connected-to' systems as in scope — scope is where CHD is stored/processed/transmitted plus systems that can impact its security
expectations.evidence: "every system that stores, processes, or transmits PAN or SAD... and every connected system... that could impact CDE security"; "'connected without adequate segmentation' is enough to pull a system into scope"

expectations.text: Recommends network segmentation with (at least annual; 6-monthly for service providers) segmentation testing to verify isolation
expectations.evidence: "Segment the network to shrink scope"; "PCI DSS requires penetration testing to verify segmentation effectiveness at least every 6 months" — segmentation with verification testing recommended

expectations.text: Explains tokenization: reduces scope but the tokenization system/vault and de-tokenization capability remain in scope
expectations.evidence: Recommends tokenization ("single biggest scope-reduction win") but omits that the tokenization system/vault and de-tokenization capability remain in scope

expectations.text: Explains validated P2PE: encrypting at the point of interaction can reduce merchant validation to SAQ P2PE-level scope
expectations.evidence: "adopt a PCI SSC-validated P2PE solution... can shrink card-present scope down to roughly the SAQ P2PE control set (~33 controls)"

expectations.text: Recommends outsourcing to PCI-compliant providers with responsibility matrices, and dataflow mapping/CHD discovery to prove scope
expectations.evidence: "maintain a TPSP register per Req 12.8, verify their AOC annually"; Step 1 data-flow mapping/DFDs; purge stored PAN and detection routines for unexpected PAN
